text: On 1 August 2023 Deborah told Jolene that she had just started a project for a community cleanup, had been trying to raise funds for it, and found it amazing to see everyone come together.
In the week of 24 July 2023 Jolene had a huge setback with her project: after a lot of work it all crashed and she lost everything, which she described as frustrating and depressing.
Deborah told Jolene on 1 August 2023 that she was sorry about Jolene's setback, that she was there for her, and asked whether anything was helping Jolene cope.
On 1 August 2023 Jolene said Deborah's support means a lot, that her pet Susie helps when times get tough, that pets have been great company, and that video games have been a nice distraction.
Jolene adopted Susie about two years before 1 August 2023, around 2021, when she was feeling lonely and wanted some company.
On 1 August 2023 Jolene said she is trying to prioritize self-care such as yoga and meditation, which helps her stay balanced and grounded.
Jolene said on 1 August 2023 that having Susie around shows her she can stay strong and find joy in the small stuff.
Deborah said one of her favorite yoga routines is a gentle flow focused on breathing and grounding that helps her find her chill, and she offered to send Jolene a tutorial video with the poses.
On 1 August 2023 Deborah recommended a yoga place to Jolene and shared a photo of a room with many yoga mats on the floor.
On 1 August 2023 Jolene said she is always on the lookout for new routines to mix things up, and she promised to practise yoga and update Deborah on how it went.
Deborah told Jolene that a gentle breathing and grounding yoga flow is a great way to find balance in tough times, and encouraged her to try it out.
Deborah told Jolene on 12 August 2023 that since they last spoke she had made a meditation guide for her yoga retreat.
Jolene said on 12 August 2023 that she had been stressed and overwhelmed since losing her work files, but meditation kept her calm and helped her get her clarity back.
Jolene shared a photo of two notebooks with a blue cover and white strip that she designed, inspired by her love of space and engines, with elements like galaxies and circuitry.
Deborah said Jolene's notebooks made her feel excited just by looking at them, and asked whether Jolene's love of art usually inspires her engineering projects.
Jolene said seeing art and design in various things gives her a unique perspective on problems.
On 12 August 2023 Jolene said she was working on a prototype that could revolutionize aerial surveillance and that she could not wait to see the results.
Jolene's aim for the aerial surveillance project is to devise a more productive and affordable aerial surveillance system that helps respond to emergencies and monitor the environment.
Jolene said on 12 August 2023 that she would keep pushing and doing her best to make a difference, and Deborah encouraged her to keep going.

On 16 August 2023 Jolene said she had been thinking a lot about her plans after checking in with her boyfriend, and that some days she felt she was juggling engineering, her relationship and personal growth.
Jolene said she had recently started time management strategies and a bullet journal, which helps her track tasks and stay organized, as of 16 August 2023.
Jolene shared a photo of her newest bullet journal spread with one of her favorite quotes, and said the quote is a reminder to stick to her goals and never give up.
Jolene said on 16 August 2023 that crossing tasks off her bullet journal list is very satisfying, and that the journal helps her stay on top of everything.
In the week of 7 August 2023 Deborah led a meditation and yoga session for elderly people at a local care home during sunset.
On 16 August 2023 Deborah said nature can be really helpful for finding peace, and she asked Jolene whether she had tried mindfulness, sharing a photo of a group doing yoga on a beach.
Deborah said she started mindfulness with workshops and books, and that mindfulness is now a huge part of her life.
On 16 August 2023 Jolene said she had not tried mindfulness yet but was keen to try it, because she is interested in destressing and could use some calm in her life.
Deborah offered on 16 August 2023 to help Jolene get started with mindfulness, saying they were in this together and to reach out if Jolene needed anything.
Deborah told Jolene on 19 August 2023 that she had told Anna the story of her life on Friday 18 August 2023, and that Anna was super kind, which gave Deborah a meaningful connection.
Jolene said she bought a console as a gift for her partner on 17 August 2023, and that the console is so much fun and her partner even managed to play it.
Jolene said on 19 August 2023 that her engineering studies were still going strong and that balance had been key for her lately.
Deborah said that in July 2023 she organized a yoga event, reaching out to nearby businesses and places, which featured yoga, food stalls and live music.
Deborah said balancing hobbies and studies works by prioritizing and managing time, making a schedule and setting aside specific time for studying and for pursuing hobbies.
On 19 August 2023 Jolene recommended Zelda BOTW for Switch as an awesome open-world game and Animal Crossing: New Horizons as really calming and cute.
Deborah said she would check out Zelda BOTW and Animal Crossing after Jolene recommended them, and asked Jolene about favorite memories of playing video games.
Jolene said on 19 August 2023 that her favorite game is hard to choose, and recommended Overcooked 2 as a hilarious and chaotic co-op cooking game.
Jolene and her partner often play Overcooked 2 for bets, and Jolene once won three large pizzas.
Deborah said she used to play video games with her husband, taking turns as a great way to bond and make memories together.
Deborah said that she and her husband prefer playing detective games together, and that they also enjoy spending time outdoors exploring nature.
Deborah said she loves a park near her house that has a forest trail and a beach, where she can do yoga and reflect on life.
A bench in that park holds special memories for Deborah and her mom, where the two of them would chat about dreams and life.
Deborah said she and her mom once watched a beautiful sunset in silence from that bench, and each time she returns she feels peace and gratitude for the time they shared.
Jolene said on 19 August 2023 that she is a big fan of being outside, which she finds calming and refreshing.
Jolene said in the week of 14 August 2023 that the console had received a new game, Battlefield 1.
On 21 August 2023 Deborah said she recently sat on a bench where she and her mom used to chat, which brought back a lot of emotions, a mix of nostalgia, longing and gratitude.
Deborah brought flowers to that bench and said her mom really loved flowers, which always made her happy, and that her mom appreciated the simple things in life.
Deborah said her mom showed her how to appreciate beauty by taking it slow, seeing beauty in things and finding joy in them.
Deborah said yoga and meditation help her find balance and inner peace, while going on walks and staying mindful keep her grounded, and she takes similar photos on her walks.
On 21 August 2023 Deborah said yoga and walks are like a reboot for her, and Jolene replied that it is like hitting the refresh button and coming back even better.
Jolene said on 21 August 2023 that she has been doing yoga for 3 years, and that it is a great way to escape studying and work stress.
Jolene said her favorite yoga pose for rest is savasana, also called corpse pose, which is so calming and helps her let go and surrender.
Jolene said on 21 August 2023 that she is trying to do more yoga and meditation to help relax and stay focused, and that she is really finding her zen again.
Jolene said a calm and peaceful feeling is great for recharging and thinking, and that going for a walk and feeling so peaceful must be amazing.
Jolene called Deborah's sunset photo over a body of water gorgeous after Deborah shared it on 21 August 2023 as part of her walking routine.
Deborah said that in the week of 14 August 2023 she went to a yoga retreat near her mom's place, where she got to hang with nature and really get to know herself, which she called life-changing.
Deborah said on 24 August 2023 that nature and self-reflection have helped her see how beautiful every moment is, and that people can grow and learn when they listen to themselves.
Jolene said on 24 August 2023 that her life has been hectic but she is making strides toward her goals, which she described as tough but satisfying.
Jolene's goal is to be successful in her field and make a positive impact, and she has been studying, attending workshops and networking to make it happen.
Jolene recently presented at a virtual conference and received positive feedback, which she said confirmed she was on the right track.
Jolene said she felt thrilled by the positive feedback, which made her efforts feel appreciated, and that she is now focusing on studying, gaining experience and considering more internships.
Jolene said on 24 August 2023 that she is not giving up and will keep pushing forward, while trying to enjoy every step of the way.
Deborah said on 24 August 2023 that she is super proud of all Jolene has achieved and that she believes in Jolene.
Deborah said on 26 August 2023 that she had been thinking about her mom's influence, and that remembering those we love is important.
On Friday 25 August 2023 Jolene and her partner talked about how their loved ones had influenced them and what their values meant to them, an emotional chat that made them feel closer.
Jolene said her mom always told her never to give up, and that her mom stressed the value of helping others, which Jolene wants to keep in mind for her engineering projects.
Jolene said her partner's dad showed the partner to stay determined, and that the loved ones' values encourage Jolene's engineering studies and her partner's creative endeavors.
As an engineering student, Jolene said on 26 August 2023 that she wants to use her talents to do good and help solve important problems, with a focus on new ideas and making things more efficient.

Jolene said she aims to work on projects that make a real difference to communities, including sustainable initiatives, innovative solutions for environmental issues and organizations focused on social causes.

Jolene said she is keen on two projects: one developing renewable energy such as solar to help communities and reduce dependence on non-renewables, and one finding ways to supply clean water to people with limited access.
Jolene said on 26 August 2023 that she still has a lot to figure out before beginning her sustainability projects, but she is up for the challenge.
Deborah advised that staying relaxed while studying can be helped by taking breaks, stretching or doing yoga, going for a walk, getting enough sleep and taking time for self-care.
Jolene said on 26 August 2023 that she has been into yoga and meditation lately, which helps her recharge, relieves tension and calms her mind.
Jolene said she has shared her love of yoga with her partner, and that the two of them are planning to go on a meditation retreat together to enhance their practice.
Jolene said her snakes enjoy watching her chill, and that one of them, referred to as she, is great company who always brings a sense of calm.
Deborah has a cat named Luna who is 5 years old, and Deborah took Luna from a shelter, as of 26 August 2023.
Deborah has a cat named Max who is 8 years old; Max is her mother's former cat, and Deborah took him when her mother passed away.
Deborah said she really loves cats, that cats need a home, love and care, and that her pets bring lots of joy and peace to her home.
Jolene asked how Deborah got each cat, praised Deborah for taming Max, and said she was proud of Deborah's action in taming the pets.
Jolene and her partner got back from a trip to Rio de Janeiro on 29 August 2023, where they checked out cool yoga classes.
Jolene said the Rio de Janeiro trip showed her different kinds of yoga and their backgrounds, which made her appreciate yoga even more, and that the couple visited many delicious cafes.
Jolene and her partner went on many excursions in Rio de Janeiro, including a visit to an old temple whose stairs were amazing.
Jolene said the architecture and history of the temple in Rio de Janeiro were really interesting to her, and that she thinks Deborah would have liked the places they visited too.

Deborah said on 30 August 2023 that she visited her mom's house last month, in July 2023, and that the house holds a special place in her heart as a symbol of her mom's strength and the love she shared with Deborah.
Deborah's husband was pictured in front of her mom's house, and Deborah said she relaxed outside there, which brought back fond memories.
Jolene said on 30 August 2023 that she goes to a nearby place to meditate by a tranquil pond with lily pads, which helps her make sense of everything and relieves stress like a restart.
Deborah said a lake with a few trees in the water is one of her favorite spots to ponder and let things go, and she chose it for its soothing vibes and nice views.
Deborah said three years ago, around 2020, she was in Rio de Janeiro and took a photo on one of the excursions of a large stone structure with a mountain in the background.
Deborah shared a photo of a handwritten note from a friend who will never be able to support her again, and said the quote reads 'Let go of what no longer serves you.' She misses him.
Jolene said on 30 August 2023 that the quote in her notebook inspires her, and she shared a quote she found while browsing about ditching negative stuff and focusing on growing and being positive.
Deborah said surrounding ourselves with good stuff and striving to improve is key, and Jolene replied that creating a good atmosphere helps people grow and improve.
On 30 August 2023 Jolene said she got a new plant as a reminder to nurture herself and embrace fresh starts.
Deborah said that in the week of 28 August 2023 she went to a cool event aimed at supporting each other, which she found pretty inspiring.
Deborah went to a community meetup on Friday 1 September 2023, where people shared stories and she felt how connected they are.
Jolene said on 3 September 2023 she has been focusing on studying and on her relationship with her partner, and the couple has been taking little trips to the beach to relax.
Jolene said on 3 September 2023 that she is really thankful for her significant other, who is encouraging her goals.
Deborah said her yoga pals have been her second family, holding each other up through a lot of things.
Deborah found an old photo from when she first started doing yoga, with her mum as her biggest fan and source of motivation, who often came to classes with her.
Jolene said that when she was 10 her parents gave her a Nintendo game console, which was the start of her passion for video games.
Jolene said she taught herself to play video games, that her dad was always supportive, and that her mom would play games with her.
Jolene said her favorite game is Monster Hunter: World, which she loves for its immersive story and open-world gaming.
Jolene said gaming is her way to de-stress and take a break from life, and Deborah said that getting immersed in a game can be freeing.
Jolene said on 3 September 2023 that she has a lot of finals coming up that month and has been studying hard, and she is thinking about a trip afterwards to relax and recharge.
On 6 September 2023 Jolene said she had signed up for a meditation course at a retreat near a lake, and she was excited to share the experience with her partner and learn new techniques.
Jolene said on 6 September 2023 that meditation helps her stay balanced during her studies, and that it is amazing how something so easy can make such a big difference to health.
Deborah said meditation has become part of her routine and that she cannot imagine her life without it.
Jolene said on 6 September 2023 that her project is tough but she is chugging along, and that she will keep pushing forward.
Deborah said on 6 September 2023 that she recently saw a wonderful sunrise, and shared a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard.
Jolene said beach walks relax her, and Deborah's sunrise photo reminded her of her last beach getaway, which was so chill and nice.
Jolene said on 6 September 2023 that she hopes one day she and Deborah will be able to watch the sunrise together, and Deborah said it is an offer she cannot refuse.
Deborah said that in the week of 4 September 2023 a storm forced her group to cancel their yoga getaway, which left her bummed.
Deborah said on 8 September 2023 that she was doing better, found comfort in her work and in spending time at home, and was reminded to be grateful for the little things.
Jolene said on 8 September 2023 that she and her partner planned a camping trip to connect with nature and practise yoga.

Jolene said on 8 September 2023 that having a routine helps her stay on top of everything, with a schedule for classes, studying and personal time, and that yoga and meditation help her stay balanced.
Jolene said her routine took a bit of experimenting but has really helped her, and she offered to tell Deborah about it.
Deborah and Jolene planned a coffee date at a cafe, and on 8 September 2023 Jolene first proposed next Monday, 11 September 2023, for fresh pastries.
Deborah recommended a cool hidden coffee shop near her home and asked Jolene to rate it.
Jolene proposed Wednesday at 4, which would be 13 September 2023, for the coffee date, but Deborah said she already had plans that day.
Jolene proposed Friday 15 September 2023 at 5 for the coffee date, as she needed to sort books out of her bookcase, and Deborah agreed.
Deborah asked Jolene to grab her some interesting books when they meet for coffee on Friday 15 September 2023, and said she was looking forward to it.
Jolene said that on the weekend of 9 to 10 September 2023 she and her partner traveled to a meditation retreat in Phuket for a few weeks, which she called an amazing experience.
Jolene said the Phuket retreat helped her find inner peace and made her realize the importance of relaxation, self-care and balance alongside her engineering studies.
Jolene said the session at the Phuket retreat that stood out to her was about releasing expectations and judgments and savoring the present.
Jolene said she usually gets too consumed with hitting her goals and forgets to appreciate the ride, and the retreat reminded her to appreciate the journey too.
Jolene said on 12 September 2023 that small things like the feeling of the sun or a great cup of coffee make life much better, and that she is trying to be more mindful and grateful.
Jolene said on 12 September 2023 that she is experiencing a new level of joy and happiness.
Deborah said on 12 September 2023 that she recently played a card game about cats in which players take cards one by one from a deck and attack opponents, but she could not remember its name.
Deborah said she and her group will play the cat card game with Jolene, and Jolene said she looks forward to meeting Deborah and playing it.
Deborah said that before 15 September 2023 she reconnected with her mom's old friends, whose stories made her tear up and reminded her how lucky she was to have had her mom.
Deborah said hearing stories about her mom from her mom's friends was both happy and sad but overall comforting, and gave her a glimpse into her mom's life beyond what she knew.
Deborah and her mom's friends reminisced and looked through her mom's photos on the day they reconnected, which Deborah called really sweet.
Deborah said the beach where she got married is super special to her, as it is where she discovered her love for surfing, and it is always filled with joy and peace.
Deborah said doing yoga on the beach is so peaceful, because the ocean, sand and fresh air create a super relaxing atmosphere.
Jolene said on 15 September 2023 that she creates her own serene yoga space with candles and oils for extra chill vibes, and Deborah replied that she does the same.
Jolene said she and her partner tried a new style of meditation in Thailand that uses flowers.
Jolene said she uses essential oils and puts on soft, soothing background music during yoga or meditation to chill out and center herself.
Deborah said it is amazing how our environment can enhance our practice, and Jolene said surroundings can affect mood and that creating a safe and chill place is key.
Jolene said she relaxes in her room, which is her little haven for peace and rest after a busy day.
Jolene said on 15 September 2023 that she has had her snake Susie for two years, and described Susie as a great companion.
Jolene said on 15 September 2023 that her pets keep her company and that pets make life a lot brighter.
Deborah said on 17 September 2023 that she and her neighbor ran a free gardening class for the community the day before, on 16 September 2023, open to people of any age.
Deborah said gardening brings people together and that she loves sharing her love of plants and helping people take care of the world.
Jolene said she and her partner tried a scuba diving lesson on Friday 15 September 2023 and had an awesome time.
Jolene said that she and her partner found a cool dive spot they can explore together, and that she hopes one day to become a certified diver.
Deborah said on 17 September 2023 that she has been interested in underwater life but has not had the chance to try scuba diving yet.
Deborah said that on Sunday 10 September 2023 she visited her mom's old house and sat on a bench, which felt comforting, as if she could feel her mom's presence guiding her.
Deborah said her mom had a big passion for cooking and made amazing meals full of love and warmth, and the smell of her special dish would fill the house and bring everyone together.
Deborah said her mom used to bake pineapple birthday cakes for her when she was a kid, which always made her feel so special.
Jolene said she used to bake cookies with someone close to her, and that her favorite cookie combines warm, gooey chocolate with a soft, buttery cookie.
Jolene said on 17 September 2023 that reading takes her to another world, and that she once read a self-discovery book in her bathroom that really resonated with her.
Deborah said she has a big bookshelf and a cozy nook where she relaxes with a book, and that having a space like this is important for escaping reality.
Jolene said she really likes Deborah's big bookshelf, which Deborah had not shown her before.
Jolene said the beach is a great place for finding peace and relaxation, and asked Deborah whether she had tried surfing.
Deborah said she has surfed and suggested that she and Jolene might try surfing together sometime, adding that it would be an adventure.
Jolene said on 17 September 2023 that she had just started learning to surf but had not gone yet, and invited Deborah to come with her sometime.
Deborah and Jolene agreed to plan a surf outing for the following month, October 2023, with Jolene saying she would check her schedule and let Deborah know.
Deborah said that in the week before 20 September 2023 she had a great time at a music festival with her friends, where the music brought them together and helped them show their feelings.
Deborah said music reminds her of her mom's soothing voice when her mom sang lullabies to her, and that she is lucky to have those memories.
Jolene said she and her partner attended a music festival last year, in 2022, which is her way of expressing herself and getting away from everyday stress.
Jolene said on 20 September 2023 that she had just got back from a trip with her partner, including an awesome yoga retreat where the sunrise lit up the whole sky with bright colors.
Jolene said doing yoga with the retreat's backdrop made her feel connected to nature and to herself, and incredibly peaceful and thankful.
Jolene said a hike with her partner led to a waterfall oasis where everything felt peaceful and her worries disappeared, which she found a refreshing experience.
Jolene said on 20 September 2023 that she plans to get out in nature again the following month, in October 2023.
Deborah said a blossom tree near her home was magical to watch bloom every spring, filling her with awe and making her appreciate the beauty of life.
Jolene shared a photo of a plant growing out of a corner of a building and said it reminds her that she can keep growing through any obstacles.

Deborah said the plant photo captures resilience and strength, and that she loves how Jolene finds inspiration in small things; Jolene said appreciating small things helps her remember there is always something positive to hang onto.
